title: 3D Visualization of a Private House Facade | DUMSKAYA
description: Concept design of a private house facade and landscaping with photorealistic 3D visualization. DUMSKAYA DESIGN, Bratislava and Vienna.
h1: 3D visualization of a private house facade and yard landscaping

blocks.text: 3D visualization of a private house facade and yard landscaping

parts.html: A concept design for the facade of a private house and the landscaping of its plot, shown in photorealistic 3D visualization. We brought the house and garden together in one scene: wall finishes, roof, windows, terrace, pool, and planting. The project comes with a video tour of the exterior that shows the facade and garden from different points on the plot.

The house has an attic floor under a gable roof. The roof is standing-seam metal in graphite gray, with roof windows and a white chimney. The walls are finished in white stucco, and the second facade material is dark wood. It clads the white-framed dormer projecting from the roof slope, the corner bay window, and the wall section by the entrance.

On the garden side, large sliding doors open onto the terrace, with a white louvered canopy above them. Higher up are two tall windows with French balconies and black metal railings. On the driveway side are a garage with gray sectional doors, a wooden front door, and a balcony with a glass railing over the porch. The gutters and window frames are dark to match the roof.

The plot is laid out on two levels. Next to the house is a wooden terrace with wicker armchairs. Below, behind a gray concrete retaining wall, is a deck with four sun loungers and a pool edged with light tiles. Wide steps connect the levels.

The planting includes lawn, grasses with fluffy plumes, large-leaved hostas, purple flowering perennials along the terrace, and trees with pink spring blossoms. By the entrance stand a shaped pine and decorative boulders. A hanging cocoon chair sits in a corner of the garden.

blocks.text: Why visualize a house before building it

parts.html: The visualization shows in advance how white stucco, wood, and a metal roof work together, where to plant a tree so it doesn’t block the windows, and how the terrace looks from the garden. We compare color and cladding options on the same model — changing them in a picture is easier than on a building site. The images and video are also useful for presenting the project and getting it approved.
We make visualizations like this for private houses in Slovakia and other European countries. For house design, see the architecture section.
